description.p: Ganot8 marks up a screenshot and hands it to someone else. Highlight a region, block out a password, underline a line of log output, point at a button with an arrow, and add a short label.

Redaction is treated as a privacy feature rather than a drawing tool. An exported image contains composited pixels only, with source metadata removed, so a redacted region cannot be recovered from the file you send. Blur and pixelate have a minimum strength, because a lightly smudged region is still readable.

ul.li: Highlight, redact, underline, arrow, text, box, ellipse, freehand and numbered badges
Move, resize, restyle and reorder anything you have drawn, with full undo
Crop and rotate, carrying the annotations with the image
Save an editable project, or export to PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF or BMP
Paste from the clipboard, or capture the screen through the desktop portal
